summary: EIOPA is consulting on a draft Supervisory Statement to promote consistent, proportionate and risk-based supervision of IBIP sales processes and pre-contractual disclosures without introducing new regulatory requirements.
title: Consultation on the draft Supervisory Statement on IBIP Sales Processes

summary: ESMA invites comments on its call for evidence concerning the tokenisation of collateral used by central counterparties, with responses due by 15 January 2027.
title: Call for evidence on the CCP collateral tokenisation

summary: The EBA’s final report proposes amendments to the prudential technical standards for central securities depositories and designated credit institutions, addressing risks when banking CSDs provide banking-type ancillary services to participants of other CSDs and updating references to reflect changes in EU legislation.
title: Regulatory Technical Standards on prudential requirements for central securities depositories (CSDs) designated credit institutions offering ‘banking-type ancillary services’

summary: ESMA’s final report sets out its assessment and final approach to revising the MAR Guidelines on delaying disclosure of inside information, including legitimate interests for delay and circumstances in which delay is likely to mislead the public.
title: Final report on the MAR Guidelines on delay in the disclosure of inside information

summary: ESMA’s final report presents revised guidelines on standardised procedures and messaging protocols between investment firms and professional clients, including changes to documentation, electronic communications, international standards and implementation timing.
title: Final report on the revised CSDR Guidelines on standardised procedures and messaging protocols used between investment firms and their professional clients

summary: ESMA’s final report sets out draft regulatory technical standards on conditions for CCP acceptance of public and bank guarantees as collateral and targeted changes to CCP investment policy requirements.
title: Final report on the guarantees as CCP collateral and CCP investment policy

summary: ESMA’s final report sets out regulatory technical standards specifying requirements for post-trade risk reduction services to qualify for the clearing obligation exemption under EMIR.
title: Final report on the Regulatory Standards on the requirements for Post-Trade Risk Reduction services for the purpose of the clearing obligation exemption under EMIR

summary: The EBA report provides technical advice on taxonomy disclosure requirements, addressing financial institutions’ key performance indicators, grandfathering, voluntary use of operating expenses, group-level reporting, and disclosure templates.
title: Report on taxonomy disclosures

summary: ESMA’s final report provides technical advice to the European Commission on selected Taxonomy Disclosure Delegated Act KPIs, including revisions to the OpEx KPI, voluntary OpEx reporting by financial undertakings, group reporting and other possible simplifications.
title: Final report on Technical Advice on selected KPIs under the Taxonomy Disclosures Delegated Act

summary: EIOPA’s advice to the European Commission proposes simplifying insurers’ Taxonomy disclosures while improving their transparency and comparability and preserving reliable information on environmentally sustainable insurance activities.
title: EIOPA's Final Advice on the review of (re)insurance disclosures under the Taxonomy Disclosures Delegated Act
